description: Upstream TAC config changes deliberately not taken into pytactl/tac_configs/. Maintained by scripts/sync_upstream_configs.py; see its docstring. An entry suppresses the upstream-config-sync pull request only while upstream still matches its fingerprint.

TAC_FTDI_16.pinout.json.note: Upstream d313724 and 665b842 drop the bootToEDL, bootToEUD, bootToUEFIMenu and bootToFastBoot sequences and add USB disconnect to the power sequences. The shortened usb_descriptor is taken.

TAC_FTDI_67.pinout.json.note: pytactl corrects sumxs2 to smuxs2 in enS230; the board has no sumxs2 pin, so upstream's enS230 cannot run.

TAC_FTDI_72.pinout.json.note: pytactl declares edl (1300), fastboot (8000) and uefi (8000), which upstream's script uses but the config never declares, so upstream's config cannot load. The values are those of the boards running the identical script (TAC_FTDI_49, 55, 63, PSOC_44, 74, 82, 87).

TAC_FTDI_77.pinout.json.note: pytactl drops the second FPPower 0 from powerOnTheDevice; it repeats the first and does nothing.

TAC_PSOC_35.pinout.json.note: pytactl 8f2c5eb shortens powerDelay from 18000 to 2000 ms; the upstream value makes RB1 reboot after it has started booting.

TAC_PSOC_7.pinout.json.note: pytactl holds pedl for 10 s more in bootToEDL. Upstream releases it with the power key, 2.2 s after power is applied; an RB3Gen2 cut off while running can take over 7 s to power on (PON by SYSOK after a UVLO), so it samples pedl released and boots from storage instead of EDL.

TAC_PSOC_82.pinout.json.note: Upstream 98aa34e adds firmware version 19 to supportedFirmwareVer.
